reviews.title: Would have been 5 - Poor business practices
reviews.text: This is an excellent app. It performs exactly as intended, provided the user does it diligently. Obviously everyone’s going to get different results. That being said, I cannot condone a 30.00 price increase in the subscription. For whatever reason. This is egregious, unexplained, and therefore unjustified increase in expense. I’ve been subscribed. I’ve tolerated the price increases. You guys arent Netflix or Amazon, and even then, I canceled those too. A 60% price increase? Get real. I’ll find my mental exercise elsewhere.

reviews.title: Don’t trust them

reviews.title: subscription increase ridiculous
reviews.text: Since the UI redesign and the change in game design and tempo, lumosity has been different and not as enjoyable. My mum, who had been playing lumosity daily for more than a decade by this point, stopped playing entirely. I stayed with it  but stopped maintaining my daily streak. I was already planning on unsubscribing before the next cycle, but today’s notification made me do it instantly. A £20 increase? In this economy? Genuinely obscene and laughable. Cancelling sub, and deleting the app. I’ll miss the train of thought game, and in general the games are good, but at the end of the day it’s just one more app that’s keeping me glued to my phone and I’m getting really tired of that — especially with the aforementioned changes. Putting down my phone and reading a book instead.

reviews.title: Ridiculous pointless app
reviews.text: Lumosity has games that are ridiculous and impossible to beat. Very frustrating. There should be a rating system so you have to play certain games less frequently than the ones you actually like. It’s such bull that you need to pay for all of the games and to get a full breakdown of progress. So the scales they give are inaccurate because you’re not getting the full package unless you pay for it.

reviews.title: Used to love it
reviews.text: I renewed my subscription every year for at least 4 years because I enjoyed the challenge of many of the games and especially LOVED the train game. I worked my way up to the top level & managed 60 trains every day. I competed against my personal best each day & used that to judge how my brain was functioning each time. However, recently they changed the program & you only got the # of trains based on how you did the last time you played, not 60 trains. When I was going thru a rough patch after a death in the family, sometimes I only got 45-50 in a session. This took away all my incentive to play the game & I will not be renewing my subscription when it runs out this year. I can no longer give it a 5-star rating.

reviews.title: Patti
reviews.text: I have been playing for over a year and whilst it is pricey at my age of 76 years It does reach my brain cells. It keeps me mentally alert and stimulated as I’m not interested in playing IT games. Although it grades on individual games it can be frustrating to attain higher goals in scores, but the brain diagram does spread eventually. The reason I have given 4 stars is the attainment goals are slow to reach and after 2 years perhaps I will change. I do have a comparison leader brain game app played together which I also subscribe to and thus app does seem to give more encouragement in its score achievements.

reviews.title: New update
reviews.text: The new update is a massive disappointment,  specifically the Train of Thought game. Once a fun challenging game (I was on level 14 with a few scores 70+) is now so frustrating.  If you make a single error there is zero point carrying on with the game since you can’t progress unless you get a perfect score. This leads to constant quitting the game and restarting.  I have cancelled my automatic subscription renewal.

reviews.title: 1 week trial not long enough
reviews.text: As the title states, 1 week trial is not long enough to ascertain whether the game is useful enough to pay for the whole year. I think it may have helped my brain become sharper, however - it’s difficult to tell because it’s only been a week. The way the app locks almost all content that I previously played lots and enjoyed is a little bit too coercive. So, thanks for the week of playing but I simply cannot make up my mind (pun intended) in that short space of time. 2 stars given because the games were relatively fun and engaging (some more than others).

reviews.title: Don’t bother with the free version
reviews.text: Developers, if you are going to offer a free version, don’t then bring up games like Feel the Beat where sound is needed, despite sound being force-muted in the free version. Fair enough you make it clear that not all games are offered in the free version,but please don’t waste people’s time by seeming to offer a game which then can’t be played and from which a player can’t move on. Just don’t offer a free version.

reviews.title: New interface/update very laggy
reviews.text:
Hello, I love your game but the new update/interface made the game very laggy, I purchased the full version of this game because I liked the “Attention” games that you offer but unfortunately, the “Trouble Brewing” and “Train of Thought” are very laggy, I’m unable to play them. For the train of thought when I click to switch tracks it doesn’t respond properly and for the coffee brewing the screen freezes momentarily when I move between stations and when I click to complete my order. I Hope you get that fixed or better just revert to the old interface where these problems weren’t there the response time was way quicker and the formate was familiar.
Unfortunately canceled my subscription until this issue of lagging and response time is fixed. 
Thanks
